g.text: DailyUserStat card shown in Analytics cluster below
name, price, rating, lat, lon, image_url?
All tables above: standalone cache tables, no relations — populated/refreshed by FastAPI services layer
Foreign key field, references parent PK
• Flight, Bus, Train, Hotel, PlaceCache, PnrCache, Landmark are standalone cache
tables populated by the FastAPI services layer — no relations to User.
• DailySystemStat, SystemAnomaly, AuditLog, CostAnalysis are standalone analytics
tables (system-wide, not scoped to a user).
• Article (blog) has zero foreign keys — fully independent of User/auth model.
• All User-owned children cascade delete except Feedback/TripAttempt (SetNull/nullable userId).
